svg.title: Fig. 6 Development-time candidate selection and rule sensitivity
svg.desc: Panel (a) shows the percentage composition of Raw, Fixed SG(5,2), and QReg selections across ten seeds for each predictor and across all 50 runs. Panel (b) shows near ties and candidate identity retained at three predefined Validation-B feasibility tolerances. The tolerance epsilon is unitless. Numeric axes use small positive-direction arrowheads. The lower right y-axis is truncated and explicitly marked with an axis break; the tested settings are discrete and no continuous response is fitted.
